question: In which year was the famous singer Lata Mangeshkar awarded the Bharat Ratna?
solution:
The correct answer is** __2001.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• In 2001, Lata Mangeshkar was awarded Bharat Ratna, which is India's highest civilian honour.
 
• **Lata Mangeshkar **was an Indian playback singer and infrequently an active **songwriter**.
 
• She is regarded as one of the best and the **most significant** **vocalists **in India.
 
• She has received honorific names like the **"Queen of Melody," "Nightingale of India," and "Voice of the Millennium" **over the course of her eight-decade career in Indian music industry.
 
• Lata recorded songs in more than **36 different Indian languages** as well as few foreign tongues, despite the fact that she mostly worked in **Marathi, Hindi, and Bengali.**
 
• Among other languages, she was also fluent in** English, Indonesian, Russian, Dutch, Nepali, and Swahili.**
 
• She garnered various **honours **and **accolades **during course of her **career**.
 
• She is honoured with the Dadasaheb Phalke Award in 1989 from the Indian government.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• 
 Mangeshkar was born on **September 28, 1929, **in **Indore**, royal city-state that was a part of British India's Central India Agency and a princely state.

 
 
• 
 Today, the district "Indore" is part of **Madhya Pradesh.**
 
 
 
 
• 
 **Deenanath Mangeshkar, **was her father, classical **Marathi **and **Konkani **singer who also performed in theatre.
 
 
• 
 Deenanath's father was **Karhade Brahmin **named** Ganesh Bhatt Navathe Hardikar (Abhisheki),** a priest at renowned **Mangeshi Temple **in Goa.
 
 
• 
 **Devadasi **and well-known musician **Yesubai Rane **was **Deenanath's mother.**
